newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jerusalem's Wailing Wall on the web.
newsitem.headline: Jerusalem's Wailing Wall on the web.

text.p: Faithful who send e-mail to God can now see their prayers being delivered to His mailbox -- Jerusalem's Wailing Wall.

Virtual Jerusalem, a company that collects the e-mail on its Internet website, said it had inaugurated a continual realtime video broadcast of the wall on Thursday, the first night of the Jewish Hannukah festival.
The company says it delivers more than 500 e-mail messages a day to Judaism's holiest shrine, where written prayers are traditionally crammed into its ancient stones.
Virtual Jerusalem's homepage is at http://www.virtual.co.il
